name: Filipino Chicken Afritada with Rice

components.name: Chicken Afritada
steps: Sauté diced onion and garlic in oil until softened, then add chicken and colour both sides briefly.
Stir in tomato sauce, broth and bay leaves; cover and simmer around 30 minutes.
Add diced potatoes and carrots; simmer another 10 to 15 minutes until tender.
Stir in peas and sugar; heat through and season with measured salt and pepper.
Ensure chicken is at least 74°C, remove bay leaves, and portion chicken/vegetables/sauce separately from rice when freezing.

components.name: Jasmine Rice
steps: Begin rice in a separate pot using 240 g dry rice and 390 ml water; simmer covered, then rest.

foodSafety: Refrigerate in shallow containers promptly: within 2 hours of cooking, or within 1 hour if room temperature exceeds 32 C.
Store at 4 C or colder for no more than 3-4 days; freeze portions intended for later in the week.
Cook chicken and reheat leftovers thoroughly to 74 C. Ground pork must reach at least 71 C before serving; food-safe reheating still requires 74 C.
Rice must be rapidly cooled and chilled; never leave cooked rice standing for extended periods.
